caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical object comprised of two main parts. The upper part is a vertical cylindrical metallic component, colored in a golden-brown hue with shading to indicate its cylindrical form. It has a slightly wider, rounded base and a long, straight neck that extends vertically upward, topped with a handle-like structure. Attached to the side of the cylinder, near the middle, is a horizontally oriented winding key colored similarly to the cylinder. The lower part consists of a flat, circular metallic frame shown in black and gray tones, divided by two perpendicular crossbars forming four segments. Within each segment, there are small spherical elements attached to the crossbars. The cylinder is connected to the ring by a small chain in the center of the circular frame. The entire composition is presented on a plain background, framed by a simple rectangular border.
title: Clock Jack
